verdict.rationale: Orrick's own pages state venture financing volume: nearly 3,000 venture financings and US$157B over 2023-2025, a Top 5 PitchBook ranking, and No.1 in Europe by deal volume. Its regional pages also describe coverage from Seed and Series A through Series C+ and from seed to growth capital. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the deal figures, named representative transactions, and a seed-to-late-stage scope stated on the main practice page rather than only on regional pages.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm's venture financing practice covers priced equity rounds from seed through late stage, with stated deal volume or representative transactions on its own pages
